g.title: J_EPS_JET
g.text: EPS J18: VBAT_JET behind SW1 and the eFuse U19

g.title: W5A
g.text: 2 x 22 AWG per pole: 0.93 A over two wires at the 12 W guard, 22 AWG derated 2 A (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2): 23 %

g.title: J_OBC_JET
g.text: OBC J3: PA9 TX via U28, PA10 RX via U29, JET_3V3 to PG6 (10 k)

g.title: W5B
g.text: 115200 baud 8N1, SMART-QSO-ICD-002 framing; twisted with its ground. Signal currents under 5 mA

g.title: J_JET_UART
g.text: carrier: UART1 RXD (header pin 10), TXD (pin 8), 3.3 V I/O rail (pin 1 via the carrier)
